name: routea_xtb
purpose: S3 registration ('GFN2-xTB force fields of the two targets are computed on the laptop from their G minima', for the x models): tetracene, then coronene when its G reference exists (probes/fetch_g_minima.sh from routea)

estimate.basis: S2 amendment 4's xtb fields: ±1–3 h per molecule up to 21 atoms; tetracene (30) and coronene (36) scaled by their Hessian counts

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run's process tree at 1536 MB (MemoryMax, tested 19 Oct), as s2_xtb
